caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic vessel with a cylindrical body that has a slightly flared, rounded rim at the top. The vessel is colored in various shades of brown and ochre, with darker tones at the base and some subtle highlights to suggest light reflection and the contours of the surface. The vessel has a short spout formed by a small notch on one side of the rim, as well as a horizontally protruding handle attached to the opposite side. The handle is thick, tapering slightly towards its end, and is rendered in the same brown tones as the body. The background of the drawing is plain and light, with no additional objects or details, and the artist's name, "LLOYD C. LEMCKE," is printed in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Bowl
